mapper.select: SELECT ID, USER_NM, ENPSWD, ACNT_STTS_CD, AUTHRT_CD FROM ADMIN_MST WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT R.RSVT_SN, R.RSVT_NO, R.SCHL_NM, R.SCYR_NM, R.RSVT_YMD, R.VST_HM, R.RSVT_NOPE, R.ACTL_NOPE, R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, R.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, R.LRN_STTS_CD, CASE R.LRN_STTS_CD WHEN 'READY' THEN '진행 전' WHEN 'ING' THEN '진행 중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.LRN_STTS_CD END AS LRN_STTS_NM, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ) AS STDNT_CNT FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_SN = R.PRGRM_SN AND P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHERE R.RSVT_YMD = #{rsvtYmd} AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY R.VST_HM DESC, R.RSVT_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STDNT_SN, RSVT_SN, STDNT_NO, CLAS_NM, CLAS_NO, STDNT_NM, ATND_YN, TEAM_NM, ASGN_NM, ROUTE_CN, LRN_STTS_CD, PRGRS_RT FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(STDNT_NO, ''), STDNT_SN) AS UNSIGNED), STDNT_SN
